name: sydney-sweeney-bunny-pink-fur-portrait
image_vibe: Playful dusty-rose bunny editorial with white ribbed styling, plush pink texture, and soft portrait lighting
image_purpose: Create a polished fashion portrait for a playful bunny-themed editorial campaign.

prompt.project_info: A 4:5 high-definition medium close-up studio portrait of an original adult woman seated on an incredibly plush shaggy pink faux-fur sofa.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with loosely wavy blonde hair and a charismatic playful expression looking directly into the lens. She wears a white ribbed knit bodysuit and a white fluffy bunny-ears headband, seated upright with her legs tucked slightly, right hand adjusting one bunny ear and left hand resting on her knee.
prompt.composition_elements: Balanced medium close-up, subject enveloped by the pink faux-fur sofa with a few pink fur pillows, solid clean dusty-rose wall behind, highly defined white knit and fur textures, and a small subtle bottom-right text overlay reading 'THE BUNNY SESSIONS'.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft flattering studio lighting with even skin illumination, gentle shadows, playful elegant fashion mood, dusty-rose and white palette, tactile plush-fur atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 portrait, professional studio photography, 85mm lens, f/2.8, realistic ribbed knit, faux-fur, hair, skin, and accessory texture, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, no extra text or watermark beyond the specified overlay.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-definition 4:5 medium close-up studio portrait of an original adult woman with loosely wavy blonde hair and a charismatic playful expression looking directly into the lens. Dress her in a white ribbed knit bodysuit and a white fluffy bunny-ears headband. Seat her upright on an incredibly plush shaggy pink faux-fur sofa with a few pink fur pillows around her, legs tucked slightly, right hand subtly adjusting one bunny ear, and left hand resting on her knee. Use a solid clean dusty-rose wall, balanced elegant composition, soft flattering studio lighting, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, highly defined realistic white knit, pink fur, hair, and skin texture, subtle film grain, and a small subtle bottom-right white text overlay reading 'THE BUNNY SESSIONS'. Do not add any other text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed bunny ears, muddy fur, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra text, watermark

assets.name: source bunny pink-fur sofa portrait
